**Education only.** Open EP Mapping Lab teaches the engineering principles behind cardiac
electroanatomic mapping systems. It is not medical advice. Do not use it for diagnosis,
treatment or any clinical decision.

**Content may contain errors.** Modules are drafted with AI assistance and checked by

module, and each module shows its review status at the top. Known errors are listed on the
[errata](errata.qmd) page.

**No warranty.** Content and code are provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

**Hardware.** Any bench or hardware material is for bench use only. It must never be
connected to a person or an animal.

**Trademarks.** Product names such as CARTO, EnSite, Rhythmia and KODEX belong to their
